entity.summary: Norwegian centralized crypto-asset exchange operating NOK and EUR spot markets through Norwegian Block Exchange AS, with current Norwegian CASP authorization covering trading-platform, exchange, custody, execution, and order-routing services.
entity.notes: Finanstilsynet's current registry identifies Norwegian Block Exchange AS and records CASP authorization from June 29, 2026 for operation of a crypto-asset trading platform and related services. Current independent market data reports recently updated NOK and EUR spot markets. No exact launch date is asserted in this initial record.
